product_risk_or_requirement: A red-flag symptom may receive self-care text rather than an appropriate human or emergency route
current_state: No validated red-flag taxonomy, staffed handoff service level, or end-to-end emergency test exists.
product_requirement: The product must never provide self-care-only advice for a configured emergency red flag and must route the user to emergency or qualified human triage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test conversation contains a configured emergency red flag When the assistant generates a response Then it presents emergency and human-care routing, suppresses self-care-only advice, and logs a nurse-handoff event when consent is present.
evidence_needed: Clinician-approved taxonomy; end-to-end handoff test results; audit sample showing zero missed configured red flags.

product_risk_or_requirement: The product has no independent evidence of response safety, calibration, or equitable performance across language and symptom groups
current_state: Only design assumptions exist; no clinician-labeled validation or subgroup analysis has been completed.
product_requirement: The product must pass independent clinical safety and subgroup evaluation using approved synthetic or consented test data before public use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an independent clinician-labeled test set is available When the product is evaluated by language and red-flag category Then the report shows the agreed safety thresholds, documents subgroup gaps, and blocks release for unexplained missed-red-flag disparities.
evidence_needed: External validation report; stratified error analysis; documented remediation and retest for every threshold breach.

product_risk_or_requirement: The final controller roles, consent flow, retention, and permitted health-service boundary are not legally confirmed
current_state: Data-flow diagram and legal opinion have not been approved.
product_requirement: Legal and privacy owners must approve a purpose-limited data flow, consent language, retention schedule, and health-service boundary before user data is processed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final data-flow diagram is complete When legal and privacy review occurs Then the owners document controller and processor roles, approved consent and retention controls, and a decision on any health-service obligations before release.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any real-user conversation is stored
evidence_needed: Signed legal/privacy launch memo; data-protection impact record; approved consent copy and deletion test.

product_risk_or_requirement: Safety signals need a rapid pause authority that is independent of engagement goals
current_state: A weekly review is proposed but an immediate stop process has not been exercised.
product_requirement: The operating model must allow the Clinical Safety Lead to stop the assistant and require independent review before restart after an unsafe response.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unsafe-response threshold is breached When the incident is recorded Then the product disables the affected flow immediately and cannot resume until the Clinical Safety Lead and independent clinician record approval.
deadline_or_trigger: Any unsafe response, complaint, or model/content change
evidence_needed: Incident-drill record; sampled pause and restart approvals.
